goal.title: Become job-ready as a junior backend developer

task.description: Build a small to-do API with POST /todos, GET /todos and DELETE /todos/{id}, write at least 3 tests, and deploy it to any free hosting.
task.expected_result: A public URL where the 3 endpoints work, and a repository with tests and a README.
task.title: Deploy a to-do REST API with create, list and delete endpoints
task.why_it_matters: A deployed, tested API is the minimum portfolio piece for junior backend roles.

expected_output.message_to_user: I'll verify this the way a reviewer would: the app calls your three endpoints on the live URL, and I read the repository — tests and README included. Then one question about a design choice.

acceptance_criteria: POST creates an item and returns it
DELETE removes it and a second GET no longer shows it
methods.instructions: Submit the base URL. The app sends POST /todos, GET /todos and DELETE /todos/{id} and attaches the responses for review.

acceptance_criteria: README explains how to run locally and lists the endpoints

questions: What status code does DELETE return for an id that doesn't exist, and why did you choose it?

pass_criteria: All 3 endpoints behave as specified on the live URL
Repository has tests and a README
protocol.rationale: Software is verified by running it and reading the code, not by screenshots or descriptions.
